ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.action.note: Opens a confirmation for a frozen set of currently eligible held messages. Dismiss all uses the existing Discard decision, never Deliver; the ellipsis signals a second step. It does not act immediately.

placeholders.count: number of messages in the frozen snapshot, a number

ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.confirm.note: The human confirms exactly the listed snapshot, not future arrivals. The explicit count label works for any number, including one; do not infer a plural selector. Each discard is irreversible and local recording does not prove server or sender notification. Some bodies may be unavailable. Dismiss and Discard refer to the same non-delivery action.

placeholders.count: number of messages in the frozen snapshot, a number

ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.submit.note: Explicitly executes the confirmed snapshot. The parenthesized count works for any number, including one, without a plural selector. Dismiss is the batch name for the existing Discard decision; never deliver or delete a conversation.

placeholders.done: number of completed row attempts, a number
placeholders.total: number of messages in the frozen snapshot, a number

ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.progress.note: Counts attempted decisions, including failed attempts, not confirmed deliveries or notifications. The count-label construction works for any numbers without a plural selector.

placeholders.succeeded: number of locally recorded decisions, a number
placeholders.failed: number of attempts without a confirmed local-record receipt, a number; a write may still have occurred if its response was lost

ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.result.note: Per-row result accounting after the frozen batch. Successful means a matching local-record receipt was received, not server-applied or sender-notified. A failed or lost response does not prove that no write occurred or that the message is still held remotely. Unconfirmed result records stay in the displayed batch result list; retry is offered only for identities still eligible in the current hold list. New arrivals were never part of this operation.

ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.retry.note: Opens another explicit confirmation only for failed message identities that remain eligible. Refreshed proofs may be used only after that confirmation; no new identities join retry.

ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.recorded.note: Local decision recording only. No server acknowledgment or sender notification is promised.

ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.stale_receipt.note: Shown when an unread discard receipt is stale. The record changed, not necessarily the text. Never claim the message was shown or ask the user to reread unseen text.

ui.teamBridge.holdsBatch.local_unconfirm.note: Core outcome discarded_local_unconfirmed is terminal locally. No additional local action is needed. Server confirmation is absent; sender notification is unknown. Do not imply delivery, confirmation or a pending retry.
